title: [storage] A storage source the extents script did not measure keeps the script's own reason in the loop's daily host.storage_bytes reading (e.g. not walked after an earlier source was over its bound), not a generic 'has no bytes'; control characters dropped, cut at 300 characters
prompt:
Spawn, objective 202 [storage] (after 180 and 185; rev-f's n2 in the review of the cc-astra A82 fix, sync/review-owner-a82-extents.md; the lead's ask of 2026-11-15; reviewer rev-g): a storage source the extents script did not measure keeps the script's own reason in the loop's daily reading.

Base: live main c096217b (180 landed as task 420).

The problem: since A82 (owner landing 4c7748e6), scripts/storage-extents.py stops walking once a source is over its bound. It answers each later source with {"name", "not_measured": "not walked: <earlier>, before it, was over its bound, so which extents it held first is unknown"}. 180's reading (crates/spawn-cli/src/storage_bytes.rs, script_entry) reads only over_bound and bytes. So it records such a source as "the extents script's answer for it has no bytes", and the `host.storage_bytes` record, and S1's note that 185 builds from each source's reason, say "not measured" without why.

Read first: crates/spawn-cli/src/storage_bytes.rs (script_sources, script_entry, not_measured); scripts/storage-extents.py (main: the answer's shapes); crates/spawn-cli/src/storage_bytes/tests.rs.

What changes (spawn-cli, storage_bytes.rs only):
- script_entry: an entry whose `not_measured` is a string is not measured with that reason, before over_bound and bytes are read.
- The reason is kept with control characters dropped and cut at WHY_MAX_CHARS (300) characters. It goes into a stored record, and onto a page through 185.
- A reason that is blank after that is no reason: the generic "the extents script's answer for it has no bytes" stands, as before.
- Nothing else changes: a source over its bound still reads "over its bound of 1200 s (<n> files read)"; a source the answer leaves out still reads "the extents script gave no answer for it"; a measured source keeps its bytes, files, unreadable and seconds.

What stays: the record's shape (each source with bytes, or not_measured as a string, as schema.sql's check requires); when and how the reading is taken; every other source's entry.

Polled reads: none (the reading is taken once a day by the loop; no store read changes).

Tests:
- crates/spawn-cli/src/storage_bytes/tests.rs: a_source_the_script_did_not_walk_keeps_the_scripts_reason (new). In the real script's shapes, transcripts are measured, build_cache is over its bound, and scratch reads "not walked: build_cache, …": scratch keeps that reason word for word, and build_cache reads its bound line. It also holds that a control character is dropped, a long reason is cut at 300 characters, and a blank reason leaves the generic one.
- No test is renamed or dropped.

Files: crates/spawn-cli/src/storage_bytes.rs, crates/spawn-cli/src/storage_bytes/tests.rs. The owner's part (202-owner.diff): rsi/scenarios/202.sh (new).
Size: storage_bytes.rs +16 -1 (code about 14), the test +48, 202.sh 281 (owner).

Acceptance: rsi/scenarios/202.sh, black box, through a real `spawn loop`'s records (180.sh's harness):
- The loop runs the extents script SPAWN_STORAGE_EXTENTS names. Here that is a stand-in answering in the real script's shapes: transcripts measured (4096 bytes); build_cache over its bound (7 files); scratch {"not_measured": "not walked: build_cache, before it, was over its bound, so which extents it held first is unknown"}, the A82 script's own line.
- With the quiet-hold file saying ENDED and no reading yet, the loop records one `host.storage_bytes` reading, in which:
  (1) scratch is {"not_measured": <that reason, word for word>};
  (2) build_cache is {"not_measured": "over its bound of 1200 s (7 files read)"}, and transcripts has its 4096 bytes, as before.
On the base (c096217b) 202.sh exits 1 with one check: "(1) scratch, not walked after build_cache was over its bound: expected [{"not_measured":"not walked: build_cache, …"}], got [{"not_measured":"the extents script's answer for it has no bytes"}]".
After 185 lands, S1's note on /api/core-lines names this reason too, because 185 copies each source's reason from the record. 202.sh checks the record itself, 180's own surface, so it does not wait on 185's code.

Proof (rev-b, sync/obj-202/202-proof.txt; guarded, owner gate ENDED 599496f4, 18:13-18:18, at o202 18656d4a on c096217b; each side a git archive, its own binary; 202.sh run with the base tree as its controller and the tree under test as cwd):
- 202.sh exits 1 on the base with the one check above, and 0 twice on the change.
- The kept 180.sh exits 0 on the change. storage_bytes' unit tests pass (11). clippy (-D warnings) and fmt pass for spawn-cli.
- Test lists 1130 -> 1131, 0 missing, 1 new.
- 5 mutants (mut202.py), each alone with its own binary:
  - by 202.sh and the unit test: reason-dropped (the base's behaviour) and after-bound (the reason kept only beside over_bound), both at (1);
  - by the unit test only: control-kept, uncut and blank-kept. They guard answers the real script never writes (control characters, reasons over 300 characters, a blank reason). A scenario's stand-in would have to answer in shapes the real producer does not write, so the unit test holds them.

Verified by: the gate runs 202.sh on the candidate. After landing, on the first live reading in which a source is over its bound, the record (and S1's note, with 185) names the not-walked source's reason. Until then the change is visible only in 202.sh, since live sources stay within their bound. rev-g reviews.
